title: phase 2: application session, position-specific guidance, and cover letter

tasks.title: Finalize phase 2 scope and acceptance criteria
tasks.description: Define exact outputs for session advice, resume-fit suggestions, and cover letter so API/data design can be fixed before coding.

tasks.title: Design phase 2 domain model
tasks.description: Model entities for application session, generated advice, resume-fit recommendations, and cover letter history with ownership and timestamps.

tasks.title: Create database migration for phase 2
tasks.description: Add Flyway migration for session/advice/cover-letter tables, constraints, indexes, and foreign keys to account and resume.

tasks.title: Implement repository layer for session and generation records
tasks.description: Add repo contracts, query objects, and jOOQ implementations for create/read/update session and generated content records.

tasks.title: Implement create/read application session service
tasks.description: Build service flows for creating a session from company/position/job description and retrieving owned session details.

tasks.title: Implement position advice generation service
tasks.description: Generate role-focused advice from job description and company/position context, then persist normalized result.

tasks.title: Implement resume-fit recommendation service
tasks.description: Generate targeted recommendations using resume content + session context, including prioritized rewrite suggestions.

tasks.title: Integrate message queue for advice generation
tasks.description: Use Redis Stream MQ for both position advice and resume-fit advice generation flows, including publisher, consumer, retry, and failure handling.

tasks.title: Implement cover letter generation service
tasks.description: Generate and store cover letters per session, with regeneration support and version/history tracking.

tasks.title: Expose phase 2 APIs
tasks.description: Add controllers/endpoints for session create/detail, advice generation/read, resume-fit suggestions, and cover letter generation/read.

tasks.title: Add validation and ownership enforcement
tasks.description: Enforce input limits, required fields, and strict account ownership checks across all session/advice/cover-letter endpoints.

tasks.title: Add tests for phase 2
tasks.description: Add unit/integration tests for services and APIs, including error paths and ownership violations.

tasks.title: Add API docs and phase 2 summary
tasks.description: Add MockMvc REST Docs snippets for new endpoints and write docs/phase-2 summary for onboarding and handoff.
